seoTitle: The Sahra Polo — Embroidered 240gsm Cotton Polo
seoDesc: The Sahra Polo — 240gsm piqué cotton, embroidered rather than printed, in sand. A limited first run. The scarcest piece in the drop. AED 229.
shareDesc: 240gsm embroidered piqué polo in sand. A limited first run.
lede: A 240gsm piqué cotton polo in sand, embroidered rather than printed. A limited first run — it is the quietest thing we make and the hardest to get hold of.
ldDesc: The Sahra Polo — 240gsm piqué cotton polo in sand, embroidered. A limited first run. AED 229.
occasion: Made for evenings that start outdoors and end somewhere better
designIntro: Most of the tees carry a place across the back. The polo does the opposite — it says almost nothing, and says it in thread. It is the piece for the days you want the brand on you without announcing it.

designCards.title: Embroidered, not printed
designCards.body: The mark is stitched into the cloth rather than printed onto it. Tonal, raised, and something you notice by touch before you notice it by sight.

designCards.title: 240gsm, not 230
designCards.body: Ten grams heavier than the tees. On a polo that difference shows — the collar stands properly instead of curling after a season.

designCards.title: A limited run
designCards.body: Made in a smaller run than the tees, and not restocked. When it is gone it is gone, and we would rather say that plainly than pretend otherwise.

printCardBody: Thread stitched into the cloth gives a subtle raised texture you can feel. It will not fade or crack the way a print eventually can — embroidery ages differently, and better.
careIntro: Embroidery is hardier than print, but the thread still appreciates a gentle wash.
care: Machine wash cold, inside out — this protects the stitching from abrasion.
Wash with similar colours, on a gentle cycle.
Hang to dry. Tumble drying is the main cause of shrinkage and puckering around stitching.
Iron inside out, avoiding the embroidery directly — never press a hot iron onto thread.
Skip bleach and fabric softener; softener coats the fibres and dulls the finish.
Watch for snags — embroidery can catch on velcro and rough surfaces.

faq.q: How is the polo different from the tees?
faq.a: Three ways. It is 240gsm rather than 230, so it is a slightly heavier cloth and the collar holds its shape. It is embroidered rather than printed. And it is made in a smaller run than the tees, counted on its own. Sizing is the same as the Regular fit tees.

faq.q: Who is the polo cut for?
faq.a: The polo is a men's cut, in one run of sizes from S to XL. It is graded to the same measurements as our Regular fit t-shirts. Because the size chart lists the garment measured flat rather than a body size, the reliable way to choose is to measure a polo or t-shirt you already like the fit of and match the numbers.

The polo is graded to the same specification as our Regular fit t-shirts — same chest, length, shoulder and sleeve measurements, S to XL. If you know your size in one of the tees, take the same here. Full measurements are in the size chart on this page and on our size guide.
It is the first polo we have made and we would rather make a small number properly than guess at demand. There is no plan to restock this run.
This is a limited first run. We may make polos again, but not this one, and we will not promise otherwise.

fitWho: The polo is graded to the same specification as our Regular fit t-shirts, so if you already know your size in one of the tees, take the same here. It has a set-in sleeve and sits at the natural shoulder — there is no oversized cut of the polo.
constructionIntro: A polo earns its place by surviving. Heavyweight 240gsm piqué cotton, finished with the construction details that decide whether a collar still stands after a year.

constructionCards.b: Heavyweight 100% cotton piqué, pre-washed for minimal shrinkage. Ten grams heavier than the tees — enough that the collar holds instead of curling.
A ribbed collar keeps its shape wash after wash, and the placket is stitched to sit flat rather than gape.
Seam tape across the shoulders reinforces the points that carry the most stress — the difference between one season and several.

fitsCardBody: A men's cut, S to XL, sized to the same specification as the Regular fit tees. Set-in sleeve at the natural shoulder — there is no oversized polo.
